description: Replace self-referential builder-vs-adapter golden comparisons in backend-adapter.test.ts with hardcoded full-string argv goldens.

userStories.title: Pin hardcoded full-string argv goldens in backend-adapter.test.ts
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need the golden characterization tests in test/supervisor/backend-adapter.test.ts to assert against hardcoded literal argv strings instead of comparing adapter output to the builder wrappers, so that the tests are a real behavior lock rather than a tautology after the CAM-339/US-003 seam inversion made the four builders thin delegations to ClaudeAdapter.buildSpawnArgv.
acceptanceCriteria: Every test in test/supervisor/backend-adapter.test.ts that currently asserts adapter.buildSpawnArgv(actor,opts) toBe buildXWorkerArgv(opts) is rewritten to assert toBe a hardcoded literal expected argv string; the expected side no longer calls any builder wrapper. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -Eq 'buildImplementerWorkerArgv|buildPlannerWorkerArgv|buildAuditorWorkerArgv|buildReviewerWorkerArgv' test/supervisor/backend-adapter.test.ts]

The four builder-wrapper imports (buildImplementerWorkerArgv, buildPlannerWorkerArgv, buildAuditorWorkerArgv, buildReviewerWorkerArgv) are removed from the test file since they are no longer referenced. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -Eq 'worker-argv|plan-argv|review\.ts' test/supervisor/backend-adapter.test.ts]

The pinned goldens cover the same actor paths currently exercised: implementer (defaults + agentName/model/container-isolation variant), planner (defaults + host-isolation/agentName/model variant), auditor (defaults + container-isolation/agentName/model variant), reviewer (all-defaults + all-fields variant). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

Each golden reflects the real per-actor differences: only the implementer goldens contain the CAM_WORKER=1 marker; the default agents are subagent-implementer/planner/auditor/reviewer; host-isolation goldens include '-u CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN' and container-isolation goldens omit it; the reviewer all-defaults golden uses the REVIEWER_TASK_PROMPT text and --permission-mode bypassPermissions. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'CAM_WORKER=1' test/supervisor/backend-adapter.test.ts]
Container-isolation goldens do NOT contain '-u CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN' (host-only unset). [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'container' test/supervisor/backend-adapter.test.ts]

The adapter-level guard tests (implementer/planner/auditor throw when taskPrompt or permissionMode is missing) are preserved unchanged. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'throw when taskPrompt is missing' test/supervisor/backend-adapter.test.ts]
No src/ file is modified; git diff touches only test/supervisor/backend-adapter.test.ts. [oracle: file-assert test -z "$(git diff --name-only origin/main -- src/)"]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint/static spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Touch ONLY test/supervisor/backend-adapter.test.ts; src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts stays unchanged (sidecar-executed worker-argv code, but not modified here, so no coherence rebuild needed after ship). Derive each expected literal from the REAL adapter output (run the adapter once and capture the string, e.g. a scratch `bun -e` printing adapter.buildSpawnArgv(actor, opts)); do NOT invent a string and do NOT keep any builder call on the expected side. Argv order (src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts:223-291): env prefix (WORKER_ENV_UNSET = -u CLAUDECODE -u CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT -u CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID -u CLAUDE_CODE_SSE_PORT -u CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH -u CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_VERSION, then -u CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN for host only), then trailing space, then [CAM_WORKER=1 ] for implementer only, then `claude`, --permission-mode, --session-id, --model (shell-quoted), --agent, then shell-quoted taskPrompt. Default isolation is 'host' when opts.isolation is undefined (so the existing defaults tests are host goldens with the OAUTH_TOKEN unset present). Default models come from DEFAULTS in src/config/models.ts (implementer/planner/auditor/reviewer) and are shell-quoted by --model, so pin them literally from real output. SAMPLE_PROMPT contains a single quote and backticks; shellEscape single-quotes and doubles internal quotes as '\'' so keep the literal exactly as the adapter emits. Mirror the literal-substring style of the sibling tests (test/supervisor/worker-argv.test.ts / plan-argv.test.ts / review.test.ts via toContain/startsWith) but pin the FULL string here. Keep the two adapter-guard throw tests verbatim. Chore, single test file, no external library surface.
